clips.title: The story
paras: At the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest, Maybell Maclure loves a Stonefield in secret. Her family’s bitter feud with the neighboring Stonefields keeps her apart from Tommy Joe Stonefield.

Maybell Maclure works the family vineyards under the shadow of a long feud with the Stonefields next door. She has fallen in love with Tommy Joe Stonefield, heir to the rival farm. Their relatives keep them apart, and Maybell searches for a way to speak with him beyond her family’s watchful eyes.
